_readme: Machine-readable marking rubrics for the constructed-response (Part B)
questions of the four MYP Mathematics Summative B papers.
Every rubric is transcribed from the mark scheme the SOURCE paper prints:
· MYP 2 / MYP 3 — the worked solution ('expl') authored with the paper;
· MYP 4 / MYP 5 — computed from the data printed in the question stem and
No answer is invented: where the printed stem and the printed mark scheme
disagree (MYP 3 Q42) BOTH readings are accepted.
Rule kinds: number | numbers | anyNumber | expr | anyExpr | words | allWords | ai
A part is capped at its own mark; the question is capped at its own mark.
An empty response is reported as needs_review, never recorded as zero.
